implementation.projection: Immutable attempt-source-context metadata preserves component/source identity, Source Version, one-based local physical page, Page Group, Placement, Activity/Version, Interaction focus, and reference-only/source-assisted correspondence. Missing, ambiguous, malformed, deleted, replaced, invalidated, revoked, or unauthorized context fails closed without a document resource.
implementation.atomicSwitch: The result adapter retains the previously committed attempt detail while the selected detail is read and validated, then commits result, response, Activity Version, source, page, correspondence, and focus in one React update.
implementation.authorization: Historical document authorization consumes immutable attempt projection plus the trusted current viewer role. Students are self-only; teachers require current owned Homework authority and student membership; teacher access to private Solo is denied. Current Delivery resolution is not used.
implementation.unavailableSource: Deleted/replaced sources render metadata and the exact 'Historical PDF unavailable' status while answer, result, provenance, and permitted feedback remain visible; no PDF host or substitute request is emitted.
implementation.privacy: No answer key, private provider/storage identity, direct database/runtime read, or broader PDF capability is added.
